text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's race day. As I'm standing on the
sidelines...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Super Creek waiting for the race
to start with a serious look in her eyes,
while Oguri Cap's
expression is oddly
blank.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: OGURI!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hyah?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right? You usually look more

relaxed...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...For some reason, when I heard people
from my hometown were going to be in
the audience... my
body just stiffened
up.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's nerves? Would eating some
candy
help?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks, I'll take some.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap takes the candy from Super
Creek and
seems to calm down.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how is it that even at a time like
this, you're
still able to look out for
others?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're racing too. Shouldn't you be
focused on
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you asked me a similar question
before,
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Since then, I've been thinking to myself. Why do I want to take care of others?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For a long time, I didn't have an answer.
But I
think I finally get it now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I want to race at full strength.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Think about it. Do you think you can run
your
best when you're nervous, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Probably... not.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right? And when you can't run to the
best of your
ability, you feel
disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I think that's probably why I look after
everyone.
So everyone can run their
hearts out.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see... You really are caring.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I don't see it that way. I just want
to race
everyone when they're at their
best! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Heh, okay. Then I'll make sure I don't
hold back!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't want it any other way! ♪ Let
the best
runner win today!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm going to pass out the rest of
the candy
to the other racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Super Creek hands out
candy to
all her rivals.
